notes: exact unhyphenated hit ('non Farm payroll'); position-trading treatment

quote: on the thursday and friday of non-farm payroll weeks they can be choppy they can be sporadic they can come back against you
statement: on the thursday and friday of non-farm payroll weeks they can be choppy they can be sporadic they can come back against you

quote: the gap forms by a vacuum of liquidity directly related to an event non-farm payroll can create a vacuum block
statement: the gap forms by a vacuum of liquidity directly related to an event non-farm payroll can create a vacuum block

statement: when the market is awaiting interest rate announcements and or non-farm payroll can create this profile in the summer months of July and August
reading: Awaiting Non-Farm Payroll (especially in July and August) produces the 'Seek and Destroy Friday' weekly profile where Monday–Thursday consolidate and sweep shallow stops.

notes: interaction with Seek and Destroy weekly profile

quote: there's usually a lot of news that comes out during the New York session okay so the 8:30 news session usually it's like non-farm payroll
statement: there's usually a lot of news that comes out during the New York session okay so the 8:30 news session usually it's like non-farm payroll

statement: we don't know where non-farm payroll is going to use the high and low that it creates after the initial run at E30

quote: unless you're ultra short term scalper and you fade that move and I don't like to do it because it's a carnival ride
statement: unless you're ultra short term scalper and you fade that move and I don't like to do it because it's a carnival ride

notes: parallel practice: general no-trade rule vs live execution demonstration / late-Friday position entry

quote: ifta Will reprice the Market below an old low to promote sell stops that will be residing there for current longholders
statement: ifta Will reprice the Market below an old low to promote sell stops that will be residing there for current longholders
reading: The algorithm reprices below an old low to trigger resting sell stops from current longs and breakout sellers, engineering sell-side liquidity at a discount.
label: QUOTE
notes: offset accumulation purpose below an old low; [sic-asr] 'ifta' for 'IPDA'

quote: what do we look for in price the liquidity pools just above an old high and just below an old low
statement: what do we look for in price the liquidity pools just above an old high and just below an old low
reading: He locates sell-side liquidity pools directly below old lows (and buy-side above old highs), looking for sweeps and rejections there.
label: QUOTE
notes: K2 seed window deepened

quote: like a fair value Gap below price or a an old low the low price if it's not obvious that it wants to go
statement: like a fair value Gap below price or a an old low the low price if it's not obvious that it wants to go
reading: He rejects taking a short trade unless price is obviously reaching for a clear downside draw such as a fair value gap or an old low.
label: QUOTE
notes: REJECTION / stand-aside when draw toward old low is not obvious

quote: if buying on a bullish order block rejection block or below an old low ideal entry technique is buying on a limit
statement: if buying on a bullish order block rejection block or below an old low ideal entry technique is buying on a limit
reading: When buying below an old low (or at a bullish order block or rejection block), his rule is to enter with a buy limit order rather than a buy stop.
label: QUOTE
notes: explicit order-type rule: buy limit below an old low vs buy stop on breaker/FVG

quote: just know that that's a good level to reach for an old low but they may not have to go through it ok
statement: just know that that's a good level to reach for an old low but they may not have to go through it ok
reading: When targeting an old low on a short, he exits near or just above the old low because price does not have to trade all the way through it.
label: QUOTE
notes: conservative target exit near an old low

quote: if buying a bullish breaker or mitigation block the ideal entry technique is buying on a stop
statement: if buying a bullish breaker or mitigation block the ideal entry technique is buying on a stop
reading: He contrasts entry order types across discount arrays: buying below an old low uses a limit order, whereas breakers, mitigation blocks, voids, and FVGs use a stop order.
label: QUOTE
notes: comparative execution matrix across discount arrays

quote: this shows underlying weakness in the cable and this is actually a false move below the old low this is going to be accumulated
statement: this shows underlying weakness in the cable and this is actually a false move below the old low this is going to be accumulated
reading: When the dollar index makes a lower low below an old low while GBPUSD fails to make a higher high (SMT divergence), the drop below the old low is a false move for accumulation.

notes: interaction between old low sweep and SMT divergence

quote: where that old low that's just outside of the last 60 days looking back there's an old low that may not be on this chart
statement: where that old low that's just outside of the last 60 days looking back there's an old low that may not be on this chart
reading: Once liquidity inside the 60-day IPDA lookback range is exhausted, price reaches for the next old low or high just outside the 60-day boundary.

notes: interaction with 60-day IPDA lookback range

quote: this is that old low that i extended on the daily chart now it's being visualized on an hourly time frame
statement: this is that old low that i extended on the daily chart now it's being visualized on an hourly time frame
reading: He marks an old low on the daily or monthly chart (W0207) and extends it onto the hourly or 15-minute chart (W0203) to frame turtle soup or OTE setups.
label: QUOTE
notes: cross-timeframe projection of daily old low onto 1h/15m chart

quote: even if it doesn't make it to that monthly high you still have the potential to find setups that would generate momentum in that direction
statement: even if it doesn't make it to that monthly high you still have the potential to find setups that would generate momentum in that direction
reading: After running sell stops below an old monthly low, price may not reach the opposing old monthly high; he warns against demanding perfection.
label: QUOTE
notes: failure to reach opposing monthly extreme after old low stop run

quote: clearing out the buy stops rolled all the way up through to 108.65 trading back to an old low that's not shown on this chart
statement: clearing out the buy stops rolled all the way up through to 108.65 trading back to an old low that's not shown on this chart

quote: you just need to know is this daily range more likely to expand higher or lower than the opening price that's it
statement: you just need to know is this daily range more likely to expand higher or lower than the opening price that's it
reading: He simplifies daily bias to determining whether the daily range is more likely to expand higher or lower from the opening price.
label: QUOTE

quote: what i have taught is power three is when you're bullish you want to be buying near or below the opening price
statement: what i have taught is power three is when you're bullish you want to be buying near or below the opening price
reading: In his Power of Three framework, the opening price serves as the dividing line to buy at or below on bullish days (and sell above on bearish days).
label: QUOTE
notes: Power of Three purpose of opening price

quote: the sell signal will occur above the opening price so anything at the opening price or above that is our selling kill ground
statement: the sell signal will occur above the opening price so anything at the opening price or above that is our selling kill ground
reading: On a bearish day, any rally at or above the midnight New York opening price is recognized as the 'selling kill ground'.

notes: recognition of selling zone above midnight opening price

quote: this right here we dropped down and went back above the opening price I don't trust this because it's Monday
statement: this right here we dropped down and went back above the opening price I don't trust this because it's Monday
reading: He rejects trusting a drop below and reclaim of the weekly opening price on Monday, preferring to wait for Monday's range to form and buy Tuesday.
label: QUOTE
notes: REJECTION of Monday weekly-opening-price reversal (~90% of the time sits out Monday)

quote: you could be a day trader selling it above the opening price above the midnight candle in new york
statement: you could be a day trader selling it above the opening price above the midnight candle in new york
reading: When higher-timeframe structure is bearish, a day trader sells above the New York midnight opening price to capture downward expansions.

quote: you want to be buying on the Judas swing down or below the opening price and don't chase price
statement: you want to be buying on the Judas swing down or below the opening price and don't chase price
reading: When bullish, he buys during the Judas swing drop below the opening price rather than chasing price higher.
label: QUOTE
notes: bullish execution rule below opening price

quote: if we're bullish we're looking for the opening price and then the market to trade down 20 to 30 Pips ideally no more than 33
statement: if we're bullish we're looking for the opening price and then the market to trade down 20 to 30 Pips ideally no more than 33
reading: For a 100-pip average daily range currency pair, he ranks a 20–30 pip drop below the opening price (up to one-third of ADR, 33 pips) as ideal compared to drops exceeding 40 pips.
label: QUOTE
notes: explicitly scaled as one-third of a 100-pip ADR ballpark, not a universal cross-asset constant

quote: with this short-term High it breaks above it so there's a shift in Market structure there so I'm looking at all of this area
statement: with this short-term High it breaks above it so there's a shift in Market structure there so I'm looking at all of this area

quote: this opening price in here what we're utilizing is the idea of power three on the weekly chart
statement: this opening price in here what we're utilizing is the idea of power three on the weekly chart
reading: He applies the opening-price Power of Three concept fractally across the daily candle (midnight NY), the weekly candle (Sunday/Monday open), and the 9:30 AM equity open (W0225).

notes: fractal application across weekly, daily, and intraday session opens

quote: this opening price here may be a little bit lower in the weekly candle which is fine we don't necessarily need it to be
statement: this opening price here may be a little bit lower in the weekly candle which is fine we don't necessarily need it to be
reading: On a bearish weekly candle, the opening price does not have to sit at the very top of the week; an initial Tuesday Judas swing above the open is expected.

notes: tolerance for excursion beyond the weekly opening price

quote: the standard natural Sunday's opening price and then I have midnight opening on Monday so it's midnight in Monday morning in New York time
statement: the standard natural Sunday's opening price and then I have midnight opening on Monday so it's midnight in Monday morning in New York time
reading: He uses 'opening price' across four distinct parallel anchors: (1) midnight NY daily open (W0211), (2) Sunday natural vs Monday midnight weekly open (W0224), (3) 9:30 AM NY equity open (W0225), and (4) the opening price of an order-block candle (W0221, W0223).
label: QUOTE
notes: four parallel referents of 'opening price' kept distinct
